## Summary

The IEEE registry lists six MA-L blocks to Chiun Mai Communication System, Inc at No. 4 Minsheng Street, Tucheng District, New Taipei City, Taiwan [1]; the first was registered in October 2016 and the most recent in December 2025 [2]. A company directory gives the same address and says the business belongs to a corporate group of 369 companies, without naming it [3].

What the company makes is thinly documented in the sources that could be read. Customs-record aggregation lists its top imports by value under HS 852990 and HS 851713 (smartphones), and its top exports as printed circuits and integrated circuits, with Fushan Technology Vietnam as its largest export buyer in 2025 [4]. Fushan Technology (Vietnam) is an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of FIH Mobile whose principal activities include manufacture and assembly of mobile phone devices, among other electronics, and Hon Hai Precision Industry is FIH Mobile's ultimate controlling shareholder [5]. That trade link suggests, but does not establish, that Chiun Mai is a phone design or manufacturing house in the Foxconn orbit, so kind and device class are inferred and parent is left unknown.

A MAC in these blocks is therefore most likely a phone or other handheld built by or for a Foxconn-group customer rather than a Chiun Mai-branded product, an inference from the trade records above [4][5]. Radios, silicon, FCC grantee codes and randomization are not listed: the company directories that describe its business, the FCC ID databases and Taiwan trade pages refused requests from the session that wrote this entry, and nothing is filled in from memory.
